game_title: Range Check Bridge – Net Menders' Pier Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier, a pier of net menders: the deckhand must handle pirate raiders while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Range Check Bridge: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross.
theme: Coastal Port – Net Menders' Pier: a pier of net menders
core_gameplay_loop: In Net Menders' Pier, repeat each round: Test ranges such as 10 <= weight < 20 to let only the right travelers cross. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the bridge_load value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about bridge_load to power up the deckhand and open the harbor gate.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 2 (intro tier): Range Check Bridge
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Check Bridge' (Week 3 slot 8), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Net Menders' Pier'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how bridge_load changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against pirate raiders in Net Menders' Pier.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 6.
